name: vsc-image-convert-ai-tool
description: A VS Code extension that lets AI (Copilot) convert images to WebP or AVIF format using configurable settings.

imageConvert.defaultOutputFormat.description: Default output format for image conversion.

imageConvert.defaultOutputDirectory.description: Default output directory for converted images. Leave empty to save alongside the original file.

imageConvert.forceOverwrite.description: Force overwrite existing converted files. Set to true to always overwrite.

languageModelTools.name: imageConvert_convert
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Converts one or more images (JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, AVIF, GIF, SVG) to WebP or AVIF format. Falls back to the extension default settings for any omitted parameters.

files.description: Array of absolute image file paths or glob patterns (e.g. /project/images/*.png) to convert. Supported input formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, .tiff, .avif, .gif, .svg

outputFormat.description: Target format. Defaults to the imageConvert.defaultOutputFormat setting.

quality.description: Conversion quality (1-100). Defaults to the imageConvert.defaultQuality setting.

outputDirectory.description: Directory where converted files are saved. Defaults to the imageConvert.defaultOutputDirectory setting (same folder as source if empty).

forceOverwrite.description: Overwrite existing files. Defaults to the imageConvert.forceOverwrite setting.

commands.title: Image Convert: Select and Convert Images
